component.name: CreatorCanvas
component.summary: A simple yet powerful image editor for content creators

description.p: CreatorCanvas is a lightweight desktop image editor that focuses on what content creators actually need: fast canvas sizing for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and Facebook, real layer control without bloat, and reliable export in PNG/JPEG/WebP.

Features include: visual template picker, drag-and-drop image import, vector shapes and Bézier paths, editable text with gradients/outline/shadow/knockout, adjustment and fill layers, selection and cut tools, painting, retouching, AI background removal, perspective mockups, batch processing, undo/redo, autosave with session recovery, layout templates and a clean dark UI.

release.description: M21–M23 feature work and hardening: clipping masks (also inside groups), perspective mockups with free-form mode, pen (Bézier) tool, marquee/gradient/retouch/healing tools, batch processing, workspace layouts, customizable shortcuts, scanline flood fill and magic wand, and DEB/NSIS packaging fixes.
Phase 2 release: AI background removal, raster tools (Crop, Scissors, Wand, Clone Stamp), Paint & Flood Fill brushes, text gradients, 3D tilt perspective, and color adjustments.
Initial release. Layers, image import, text, shapes, presets, undo/redo, export.
